_readme: One entry per scenario (game type), whatever its stage. status: live = has code in src/games/<id>/ and may be scheduled; approved = chosen to build next; proposed = not yet decided; rejected = not building, with the reason. Each entry has a spec sheet in content/scenarios/<id>.md.

scenarios.name: Chests
scenarios.idea: everyone-piles-on

scenarios.name: Junction
scenarios.idea: let-the-reaction-finish-it

scenarios.name: Pirates
scenarios.idea: buy-the-cheapest-votes

scenarios.name: Agenda
scenarios.idea: favourite-enters-last

scenarios.name: Duel
scenarios.idea: miss-on-purpose

scenarios.name: Two Lots
scenarios.idea: Set the rival’s price
scenarios.note: Pick for the bidding family; simpler than the ladder version.

scenarios.name: Auction Booth
scenarios.idea: Charge for entry without losing competition
scenarios.note: Entry fees, budgets and bids interact in ways too hard to follow in 3 minutes.

scenarios.name: Tile Stack
scenarios.idea: Leave the right remainder
scenarios.note: Classic take-the-last-tile puzzle; easy to read.

scenarios.name: Pie Relay
scenarios.idea: Bake what unlocks the next job
scenarios.note: Oven-heat matching is fiddly to read and the idea is weak.

scenarios.name: Delivery Bond
scenarios.idea: Set a bond the courier can afford
scenarios.note: Promising trust puzzle; needs a simpler way to show bond and fee.

scenarios.name: Parcel Line
scenarios.idea: Clear space for the right inspector
scenarios.note: Inspection windows and two flags per parcel take several readings.

scenarios.name: Ferry Launch
scenarios.idea: Fill seats to leave sooner
scenarios.note: Fun idea; check that boarding order and launch times read clearly.

scenarios.name: Cookie Cut
scenarios.idea: Give away quantity and keep quality
scenarios.note: Simplest splitting puzzle in either set.

scenarios.name: Last Ballot
scenarios.idea: Back a rival to redirect the transfer
scenarios.note: Good hard voting round (ranked ballots).

scenarios.name: Snow Lines
scenarios.idea: Draw the strongest defender away
scenarios.note: Clearer than Three Towers, which has the same idea.

scenarios.name: Two Lots (ladder version)
scenarios.idea: Overbid Lot 1 to drain a rival's wallet for Lot 2
scenarios.note: Same idea as Two Lots with more rivals; keep as a harder variant.

scenarios.name: Mystery Box
scenarios.idea: Account for the winner's curse: winning means informed rivals walked away
scenarios.note: Winner’s curse with stated odds; suits hard rounds.

scenarios.name: River Fork
scenarios.idea: Work backward from the final forks to see where each branch ends
scenarios.note: Good idea, but needs a branching river map: new art and layout. Revisit later.

scenarios.name: Magic Pond
scenarios.idea: Trim the resource just under a rival's trigger without killing regrowth
scenarios.note: Fresh thinking-ahead idea.

scenarios.name: Chip In
scenarios.idea: Seed just enough to start a chain of conditional cooperators
scenarios.note: Seed a chain of conditional helpers; clear and new.

scenarios.name: The Pact
scenarios.idea: Stay loyal while the alliance holds, then defect the exact day a traitor breaks it
scenarios.note: Repeated trust game; check it reads well in 3 minutes.

scenarios.name: Roadblock
scenarios.idea: Remove a tempting shortcut so drivers spread across separate roads
scenarios.note: Braess’s paradox; keep settings small enough to solve in your head.

scenarios.name: Cake Cut
scenarios.idea: Slice so rivals grab bulky low-value chunks and leave a dense gem behind
scenarios.note: Fair’s second cut has too many tie rules to read quickly.

scenarios.name: Roll Call
scenarios.idea: Vote away from your favourite so an underdog voter launches a bandwagon for it
scenarios.note: Best “aha” in either set and easy to read.

scenarios.name: Three Towers
scenarios.idea: Bait a rival to overspend on one tower so you hold the flanks
scenarios.note: Same idea as Snow Lines; keep as a variant.
